basic_profile.bio: Just a regular person diving into the world of Reddit and trying to catch 'em all in Pokémon GO. Based in San Francisco, CA, I spend my evenings hunting for rare Pokémon and connecting with fellow trainers. I'm a part-time graphic designer and a full-time dreamer. I love binge-watching anime like Angel Beats and listening to live music, especially at festivals like BottleRock. Not a big fan of overly crowded places but love the vibe of a good concert. I’m single and often online in the late evenings, usually from 9 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I’m still learning the ropes in the Pokémon GO community, mostly picking up tips from Reddit threads and YouTube videos. My knowledge of perfumes stems from my part-time job where I often design promotional material for fragrance brands. My interest in Goosebumps and horror stories comes from childhood nostalgia and a love for thrilling tales.
